reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "200 mg" on the front, and then I saw it is two capsules of 100 mg each, so I did the math: $1.00 a day against about $0.39 for Nature Made. But it is real bisglycinate with no oxide, the sachets fit in my carry-on, and the QR batch report is something I can actually check, so I would try one box for travel and sleep.
objection: A brand with zero reviews at 2.5x the price per serving of the drugstore stuff. I am paying for sachets and a lab report on faith until someone else has bought it.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews, or a lower price per day (around $0.75) would make me reorder instead of just trying it once.
